_what: Long or heavy automation runs in a process of its own, supervised (computer/supervised-run.mjs); short work stays in the host that asked. A `classes` row says how a kind of run is supervised: its wall clock, whether the Mac is kept awake for exactly as long as the process lives, how much output is kept and how it is stopped. `keep_awake` is the program that holds the Mac awake and the arguments that tie it to the process ({pid}). A class not listed here is refused, so a caller names how heavy its work is.

words.unknown_class: There is no supervised class named {class}. Use one of: {known}.
words.needs_argv: A supervised run needs argv, the program first and its arguments after.
words.timed_out: The process was stopped after {ms} ms.
words.failed_to_start: The process could not be started: {error}
